output.question: Where can I find Target's latest annual report?
output.answer: Target Corporation's (NYSE: TGT) latest annual report is the 2025 Annual Report, which covers the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026. It's on Target's investor site at https://corporate.target.com/investors/annual/2025-annual-report/report-home. The full PDF is at https://corporate.target.com/getmedia/79214b4b-6331-4b1c-b76f-acff121b40f9/2025-Annual-Report-Target-Corporation.pdf. The Form 10-K can be read online section by section, starting at the cover page (https://corporate.target.com/investors/annual/2025-annual-report/10-k-report/10-k-cover). You can also download it from the 'Download Report' page (https://corporate.target.com/investors/annual/2025-annual-report/download), where you pick which sections to include, such as the CEO letter, financial highlights and the 10-K. The next report, for fiscal 2026, would normally come out around March 2027.

key_facts.fact: The latest Target 10-K is for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026, which Target calls its 2025 Annual Report.

The download page offers a PDF of the full 2025 annual report and a custom download that can include the 10-K (707kb), the CEO letter, financial highlights, the financial summary, directors and management, and shareholder information.
The 10-K cover page lists 452,855,589 shares of common stock outstanding as of March 4, 2026.

passages.quote: For the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026
Total shares of common stock, par value $0.0833, outstanding as of March 4, 2026, were 452,855,589.

caveats: A third-party site that collects filings says the 10-K was filed with the SEC on March 11, 2026. I didn't check this on SEC EDGAR or on a Target page.
Target names its annual report after the fiscal year, so the '2025' report covers February 2025 to January 2026. The fiscal 2026 report isn't expected until about March 2027.
The Reports & Filings page (corporate.target.com/investors/reports-filings) returned a 404 error. The links above come from the 2025 annual report pages, which did load.
You can also get the official 10-K from SEC EDGAR by searching for Target Corp (ticker TGT, Commission file no. 1-6049). I didn't open that page.
